title: Halal Entrepreneurship: Riba-Free Business & Shariah Finance
description: How to finance and build a business within Islamic law: murabahah (cost-plus financing), profit-sharing partnerships, riba-free banking, and handling suppliers even when they use riba. Sheikh Assim Al Hakeem and AMAR (AMAU) - Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan, Islamic Finance Guru.
short_description: Finance and build halal businesses - murabahah, profit-sharing & riba-fee trade

modules.title: Shariah Financing for Business
modules.description: Murabahah, profit-sharing and the rulings of financing.

lessons.title: Islamic Finance: Murābaḥah, Installments & Ribā Clarified
lessons.content: Murābaḥah (cost-plus profit financing) and installment sales: how Islamic financing works without riba. source: AMAR — AMAU's Arabic-language broadcasts (https://www.youtube.com/@AMARofficial); Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan, translated in English

lessons.title: I Invested in Business Through Profit Sharing but Other Investors Use Riba — Is That Okay?
lessons.content: Accounting for riba in partnerships where some partners engage in riba: the ruling and practical steps. source: Sheikh Assim Al Hakeem (assimalhakeem, https://www.youtube.com/@assimalhakeem) — Salafi scholar, English-language fatwa Q&A from Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

lessons.title: Is Islamic Financing Halal?
lessons.content: What Islamic banks actually do and whether to take their financing - honest analysis of products on offer. source: Sheikh Assim Al Hakeem (assimalhakeem, https://www.youtube.com/@assimalhakeem) — Salafi scholar, English-language fatwa Q&A from Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

lessons.title: Keeping Money in a Bank That Deals with Riba
lessons.content: Every bank uses riba in some way: where to keep your business funds. source: Sheikh Assim Al Hakeem (assimalhakeem, https://www.youtube.com/@assimalhakeem) — Salafi scholar, English-language fatwa Q&A from Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

modules.title: The Halal Entrepreneur's Character
modules.description: The work ethic, honesty and barakah every founder needs.

lessons.title: One Quality That Shows That You Are Truly Honest with Allah
lessons.content: Honesty as the single most powerful quality in business and life - and how to develop it. source: Sheikh Assim Al Hakeem (assimalhakeem, https://www.youtube.com/@assimalhakeem) — Salafi scholar, English-language fatwa Q&A from Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

lessons.title: Give Me 61mins and I'll Show You How To Build A Halal Business (Islamic Finance Guru)
lessons.content: Practical guide to launching a Shariah-compliant venture from idea to first customer. Islamic Finance Guru.
